title: Admin Course CRUD — 編輯/刪除/新增課程表單
content:
Courses 列表頁已存在（admin/courses/page.tsx），但「New Course」按鈕指向 placeholder。缺少編輯、刪除、新增功能。

功能需求：
- New Course 表單（完整的 course create form）
- Edit Course（從列表點擊進入編輯）
- Delete Course（含確認對話框）
- Toggle registration status（OPEN/CLOSED）直接從列表操作
- i18n 支援
- 表單驗證（Zod schema 對應 Course model）

API 已存在：POST /api/admin/courses、PATCH /api/admin/courses/[id]、DELETE /api/admin/courses/[id]（CM-001 已完成）。

evidence.residual: Existing CM-001 API routes need verification that POST/PATCH/DELETE work for full course model with all fields.

acceptance: New Course form creates course via POST /api/admin/courses
Edit Course form pre-fills data and saves via PATCH /api/admin/courses/[id]
Delete button shows confirmation dialog, removes via DELETE /api/admin/courses/[id]
Registration status toggle (OPEN/CLOSED) works from list view inline
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
files: src/app/[locale]/admin/courses/page.tsx (refactor — add edit/delete/toggle actions per row)
src/dictionaries/types.ts (update — add course form keys to AdminDict)
dependencies: CM-001 provides POST/PATCH/DELETE API — verify completeness before starting.
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && create a course, edit it, delete it, toggle status — all via admin UI.
